segmentation.name: LitePT-S
segmentation.tta: Unmodified official small-v1m1 test transforms: initial 0.025m voxelization, 0.05m fragment voxelization, five scales and their flips
segmentation.probabilities: Float32 softmax votes averaged per point, restored to original order; argmax must equal native vote argmax

tracking.name: MCTrack
tracking.thresholds: Unmodified upstream CenterPoint online thresholds, applied to LION-Mamba
tracking.history: Capture once after native predict and before native association/update; reset at scene boundaries

history: Fresh empty MCTrack per target; process allowed past scans in chronological order; predict before current observation. Same original thresholds/noise, actual measured dt and backward-prediction interval; no prior full-scene KF read.

tool_actions.REFINE_CENTER: Copy original LION box and replace XYZ translation only; preserve all other fields exactly
tool_actions.ADD_BOX: Use frozen full candidate only when original association target is null; independent operation
tool_actions.LEGACY_REPLACE_BOX: Explicit ablation, copy complete frozen candidate; old artifacts immutable

det_oracle.objective: Unchanged lexicographic sum(TP-FP) at0.5/1/2/4m then negative sum matched xy distance; official range/rack filtering; no-op wins ties
det_oracle.reproduction: Native fixed candidate order, first improving candidate per original target; exact v3 replay required
det_oracle.grouped_main: Original target order descending detector score then index; compare current no-op with every available frozen center for that target; choose largest objective, first candidate wins exact non-noop ties; each target once; single-tool controls use same selector
det_oracle.joint_pool: Interleave native Tracking and Segmentation candidate order, Tracking first. No averaging, fitting or GT-generated centers
det_oracle.candidate_budget: Per-frame B=min(number of refine candidates from Tracking, Segmentation, fixed temporal). Every matched-budget branch sees exactly B candidates: native prefix for singles, interleaved prefix for joint. B uses no GT, may be0. Variants count separately; actual accepted operation counts reported
det_oracle.add_ablation: ADD_BOX selected independently on baseline; joint pool alternates sources; combo first applies REFINE_CENTER selection then greedily considers ADD_BOX candidates; single combos use reproduction selector and joint combo uses grouped selector. No summed AP/NDS claims

seg_oracle.inputs: Same original LitePT-S labels; existing Det->Seg and strict Track->Seg candidates. Det->Seg identical original algorithm re-run only on80 corrected detector input frames, no model inference; unaffected candidates/output labels verified
seg_oracle.unit: Frozen candidate region with fixed predicted labels; best positive net correct non-ignore points among existing boost variants; no-op on ties; at most one variant per source region
seg_oracle.conflict: Alternate complete source regions Det first, preserving each native source order. Already modified point indices are excluded by a GT-free first-accepted-region mask; cannot select arbitrary GT-correct subsets
seg_oracle.candidate_budget: B=min(number of Det->Seg candidates,number of Track->Seg candidates) perframe; single native prefixes and mixed joint prefix have exactly B variants, grouping afterward; no GT budget allocation
seg_oracle.metrics: Full16 official LidarSegEval, independent aggregate confusion crosscheck; all16class IoU, object10/background6 and frame/scene effects; independent repair/overlap/conflict counts

threshold_tuning: Forbidden on full Validation; reuse every existing tool threshold and checkpoint
joint_scope: Two independent destination-task experiments; no circular feeding of Oracle-refined detections back into segmentation
statistical_reporting: Scene-level paired bootstrap for segmentation from stored confusion matrices only; no claim of deployment or seed robustness
